posts.meta_description:
94K likes, 3,458 comments - kayla_itsines on September 25, 2026: "Do I have a story for YOUUUU! 
Wow. 

Imagine waking up and thinking it’s going to be a completely normal.. business as usual day … and then ONE conversation changes the entire trajectory of your life. 

All it took was one question, “do you have any advice for me?” 

Which turned into … 

1,000km bike ride from Gold Coast to Sydney, over 8 days, camping in the cold, raising money for mental health, with no expectation other than helping others and getting the chance to be in the same room as his idols. 

@mrlumore , it’s been an absolute HONOUR to watch this journey. You deserve this life. 

He said, “After losing my dad to dementia, seeing his life cut short - I’ve realised, life is short. I just want to prove to myself that I can do hard things whilst also raising money for a cause I am so passionate about and that’s so close to my heart”. 

To @steven and @tonyrobbins , it was heartwarming to watch you get around this incredible human. You’ve changed a young man’s life today and inspired thousands in that room to believe in themselves and their dreams. 

This is a story I’ll never forget 🙌🏼🫶🏼".

67K likes, 1,859 comments - kayla_itsines on March 12, 2026: "I’m SO proud to announce that as of today I am the sole owner of @sweat 

I cannot believe I am saying this… it feels so surreal 😭

Sweat was created for women and it’s always been a goal of mine that one day I could say that Sweat is solely ran by a woman.

And today… I can. 

That means more to me than anyone will ever know.

I believe so strongly in what we’re building for women around the world and this is only the beginning.

This moment feels like the start of our most exciting chapter yet.

Thank you for being part of this journey with me, I will do everything I can to make you proud 💛".

posts.meta_description:
46K likes, 1,333 comments - kayla_itsines on April 28, 2025: "Trying to summarise my entire journey in one post... 👆 

Sometimes I think about what I would say to 18-year-old me if I could go back in time… standing in my parents’ backyard with a whiteboard, training my clients, with absolutely no idea where this journey would take me.

Back then, I was just a personal trainer passionate about helping women feel strong and confident in their own skin. I never imagined that passion would turn into a global community... or that I’d become the co-founder of an incredible business like @Sweat.

I’m SO proud of how far Sweat has come, but it hasn’t always been easy. There have been long days, self-doubt, mistakes and plenty of lessons. But through it all, one thing has never changed... my love for helping women move their bodies, build their confidence, and feel empowered every single day.

To every woman who’s ever trained with me, used the @Sweat app, or simply shown up for herself, thank YOU. You’ve helped me grow from a young PT in Adelaide to someone who is part of the most incredible global community of women, and I can’t WAIT to keep growing with you.".

9,704 likes, 130 comments - kayla_itsines on October 27, 2026: "House things 😍
We are at a 3-4 week countdown with our Gold Coast home renovation and it’s sooooo exciting!! 

Please direct all your questions about stone, tiles, joinery, paint colours and wood selections to @honghenwood HAHAHAHAAAA 🤣 No... don’t do that. I can literally hear her overstimulated voice “KAYLA DO NOT, I can’t do social media right now I’m so BUSYYYY” all the way from Noosa 🤣🤣 

No I PROMISE I’ll make a list of everything for you guys. Let me know what you want the details of and I’ll create a FAQ because I know so many people love pulling small things here and there for inspiration. 

We actually used the things that we love from both our previous Adelaide houses and then a brand new stone which is VERY out there… but we love it 😍😍 

Interior designer: @honghenwood 
Builder: @dbbuild (we used the same builders that built the ORIGINAL house that was here) 

Right now the walls all look green because of the green protectant on the flooring, so ignore that. Other than that, these are the little things I love. More to come :) 

I’ll come back with that list !!".

1,045 likes, 19 comments - kayla_itsines on October 29, 2026: "It’s so easy to get stuck doing the same things because they work... but there’s something really valuable about staying open to evolving your training.

I showed @jetayagc some of the core exercises I’ve been doing for YEARS and now I have evolved versions of them that are going to be part of my weekly split

If you want to train with both of us, Strength & Pilates in the @sweat app has my strength sessions and Jetaya’s Pilates side by side every week, plus so many more core workouts like these. Try it free for 7 days with the link in my bio 🫶🏼

What’s a workout you’ve been doing for years that you’d love a new spin on? Drop it below and I’ll pick some to make a video on it 👇🏽".

6,159 likes, 106 comments - kayla_itsines on October 27, 2026: "If you’re ever doubting yourself… just remember to look through their eyes 🥹

I always come back to my “why” and why it’s so important to never lose sight of it.
Arna will never understand how much this voice note helped me. 

I want to build something that changes women’s lives, that helps women feel stronger, healthier and more confident in themselves. But I also want to show my kids what’s possible.

I want them to grow up knowing that you can have big dreams, work incredibly hard and build something you truly believe in….and that being a parent doesn’t mean putting your dreams aside.

Some days are harder than others, but when I come back to my why, it reminds me exactly why I started and why I’ll never stop. ❤️".

posts.meta_description:
2,895 likes, 40 comments - kayla_itsines on October 23, 2026: "How you do anything… is how you do everything.

Social media is a highlight reel. You see someone's "overnight" success and forget there were years of quiet, unglamorous days behind it that nobody posted.

People see Sweat now but what they didn't see were, years of backyard PT sessions, the early mornings, the burnout and days it didn’t feel worth it…

So when your own progress feels slow and repetitive, that doesn't mean it isn't working. That IS the work.

And honestly, that's what makes it so fulfilling when you get there... because you know exactly what it took 🤍".
